title: Assessing the Clinical Relevance of BRCA1 RING Domain Variants of Uncertain Significance.
authors: Martin, Matthew D; Torretto, Gabriella C; Islam, Kaamraan; Archer, Nicole E; Feilotter, Harriet E; Davey, Scott K
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习与实验评估BRCA1 RING结构域变异对BARD1结合的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关蛋白但非TF-DNA体系，且无三维互作建模或动态机制研究，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: The BRCA1 protein serves an essential function in maintaining genomic integrity, to the extent that up to 80% of women carrying a pathogenic BRCA1 variant develop breast cancer (BC). Most of these carriers would benefit from prophylactic care, but genetic screens that uncover variants of uncertain significance (VUSs) do not provide insight on disease risk or clinical decision-making. In accordance with guidelines established by The American College of Molecular Genetics (ACMG) and Association for Molecular Pathology (AMP), this study produced computational and functional evidence to inform the reclassification of BRCA1 VUSs as pathogenic or benign, with a specific focus on the abundant subset of missense variants within the RING domain. A six-feature linear support vector machine (LSVM) specifically trained on BRCA1 RING variants performed well (84% accurate in predicting in vitro binding loss) and provided supporting classification evidence for 322 VUS. A mammalian cell co-immunoprecipitation (co-IP) assay that quantified the binding between variant BRCA RING constructs and endogenous BARD1 provided corroborating strong evidence for nine VUSs and correlated with a homology-directed repair (HDR) assay by Starita et al. (p = 0.04). The combined evidence warrants the reclassification of three VUSs as likely benign (N16S, A17D, and E100D) and one as likely pathogenic (H41P), and underscores the promise of domain-specific approaches for missense VUS reclassification.
abstract_zh: BRCA1蛋白在维持基因组完整性方面发挥着至关重要的功能，以至于携带致病性BRCA1变体的女性中高达80%会发展为乳腺癌（BC）。这些携带者中的大多数将从预防性护理中受益，但揭示意义不确定变体（VUSs）的基因筛查并未提供关于疾病风险或临床决策的见解。根据美国分子遗传学学院（ACMG）和分子病理学协会（AMP）制定的指南，本研究产生了计算和功能证据，以支持将BRCA1 VUSs重新分类为致病性或良性，特别关注RING结构域内丰富的错义变体亚群。一个专门针对BRCA1 RING变体训练的五特征线性支持向量机（LSVM）表现良好（在预测体外结合丧失方面准确率为84%），并为322个VUS提供了支持性分类证据。一项哺乳动物细胞共免疫沉淀（co-IP）实验量化了变体BRCA RING构建体与内源性BARD1之间的结合，为九个VUS提供了确证性有力证据，并与Starita等人的同源定向修复（HDR）实验相关（p = 0.04）。综合证据支持将三个VUS重新分类为可能良性（N16S、A17D和E100D），一个为可能致病性（H41P），并强调了针对结构域特异性方法在错义VUS重新分类中的前景。
